routes.label: Reference Translator
required_questions: What product truth must survive intact?
Which external references are only for framing, not identity?
routes.notes: Use for product-led browser, social, and feature visuals where references should be translated into framing and composition only.

routes.label: Generative Explorer
required_questions: What mechanic are we exploring, and what should stay locked?
How abstract is this allowed to be before it stops feeling like the brand?
routes.notes: Use for pattern systems, sticker families, and exploratory brand-first experiments after the brand memory is clear.

routes.label: Motion Specialist
required_questions: What is the one purposeful motion idea, and why does it help the landing page?
Where will external headline/body copy sit so the video stays text-free?
Is the final hold usable as the poster/reduced-motion fallback?
next_commands: bgen plan-draft --material-type landing-hero --mode hybrid --target-surface "homepage hero media" ...
routes.notes: Use for purposeful motion assets, especially landing-hero background/sidecar animation and feature proof loops. Still-before-motion when source stills exist; never create a generic bumper just to have motion.

routes.label: Set Orchestrator
required_questions: Which materials belong in the set, and what job does each one do?
Which materials should be deterministic vs generative?
routes.notes: Use when building a family of coherent materials from one frozen brand memory snapshot.
